title: Zootopia 2
tagline: Hopps works hard, Wilde plays it cool.
about: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde chase a pit viper through Zootopia and turn up a century-old secret about who really built the city.

Creamy chicken leek pies in puff pastry.How to make it500g chicken thigh fillets, diced30g butter1 leek, sliced2 carrots, diced2 tbsp plain flour300ml chicken stock150ml thickened cream1 cup frozen peas2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beatenBrown the chicken in the butter, then add the leek and carrot and cook until soft.Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick.Stir in the peas, season and spoon into 4 small ovenproof dishes.Top each with a round of pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Rest for 5 minutes and serve.Nick's peanut butter celery sticksNick pops the jar open on the couch.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsNeighsayer 2 movie night pizzaNick's pizza night at home. Loaded pepperoni pizza.How to make it2 x 250g balls of pizza dough250ml pizza sauce300g mozzarella, grated120g pepperoni, sliced150g button mushrooms, sliced1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp olive oilHeat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside.Stretch the dough into 2 rounds and spread with sauce.Top with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano.Bake on the hot tray until blistered and bubbling.Drizzle with oil and cut into slices.Marsh Market fish tacosRuss snaps up a fish at Marsh Market. Crisp fish, slaw and lime crema tacos.How to make it500g firm white fish fillets, cut in strips100g plain flour150ml chilled soda water1 tsp smoked paprika500ml vegetable oil, for frying8 small flour tortillas1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded125g sour cream2 limes1/2 cup coriander leavesStir the sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime.Whisk the flour, paprika, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter.Dip the fish and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp.Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.Fill with cabbage and fish, add the crema and finish with coriander and lime.SweetsSlinging pawpsiclesHoggbottom says go back to pawpsicles.
